rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality early/full blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it is somewhat equivocal between 2AA and 3AA and adds little on zona pellucida or specific visible morphology.

Integrates age, FSH, BMI, endometriosis, prior biochemical pregnancy, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle with prognosis reasonably well, though AMH is unavailable and some interactions are discussed only broadly.
Overall logic is understandable, but there are internal inconsistencies around day-4 grading/staging and probability ranges, and some speculative comments weaken the chain of reasoning.

Mostly evidence-based in recommending SET and avoiding unsupported add-ons, but there are deviations such as implying 13 mm may be 'too thick,' discussing trigger optimization without case-specific basis, and suggesting ICSI for endometriosis without clear indication.
Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, review of cycle factors, cavity/endometriosis reassessment, and when not to escalate to add-ons.
